unit_label: BRBL::MOD_C::U19: Distinguish unfair contract,unfair trade practice and consumer information rights

payload.title: Separate a harmful term from a misleading sales practice
payload.core_explanation_md:
An unfair-contract concern focuses on the terms and their effect on the consumer, such as manifestly excessive security, a disproportionate penalty or an unjustified one-sided power. An unfair-trade-practice concern can arise from misleading claims, false bargains, unfulfilled promotional promises, the described receipt/refund failures or improper disclosure of confidential information. The same file may require more than one analysis.

Consumer rights include information, safety, hearing and redress; a signed standard form does not automatically prove every term is fair. Preserve what was promised, the actual terms, what was charged and the information supplied. Do not infer statutory approval or affiliation from an advertising claim alone.

self_check.prompt_text: Does a signed form by itself prove that all its terms are fair?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The statutory unfair-term analysis remains separate.

payload.stem_md: A sales message claims a product has official approval with no supporting evidence. Which concern is directly raised?

options.text_md: Only whether the paper is stapled correctly
options.explanation_md: That does not address the representation.

options.text_md: The customer must disprove every imaginable approval
options.explanation_md: The actual claim needs a factual basis.

options.text_md: A potentially misleading representation of approval or affiliation
options.explanation_md: The source identifies such deceptive claims as relevant.

options.text_md: Every product with an advertisement is automatically unlawful
options.explanation_md: Advertising alone is not the identified defect.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The source identifies such deceptive claims as relevant.

payload.stem_md: A penalty clause bears no reasonable relationship to the stated breach loss. The reviewer considers only whether the customer signed. What is missing?

options.text_md: The statutory unfair-contract analysis of the term effect
options.explanation_md: Signature alone does not settle fairness.
Profit preference does not determine the legal test.

options.text_md: An assumption that every penalty is prohibited regardless of facts
options.explanation_md: The actual term and statutory criteria matter.

options.text_md: A claim that every fee is a tax
options.explanation_md: Contract charges and taxes are distinct.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Signature alone does not settle fairness.
